messages:
max_sales: quick handoff for Sycamore Systems — enterprise pilot signed today. Committed Dedicated (3x A100) with VPC peering + SAML. Data residency: EU only. Exec sponsor: Anya Petrov (CTO). Pilot target 2024-06-12. Known risks: SSO cert rotation window, corporate firewall blocking peering ports, and initial extraction accuracy on legacy labels. sharing prompt pack link. tagging @talia_cs and @priya_eng to pick up. :handshake:

talia_cs: I can take CSM ownership. I'll run kickoff and lead enablement. Max please drop legal/billing contacts and confirm whether they want audit logs to their EU S3 or to our retention for pilot. Also need the customer's network contact for peering form.

evan_csm: Day-to-day CSM support. Planning kickoff week of 6/3. Can we confirm model pin and pool sizing? Will they want nightly evals vs weekly? Also request eng/SE join a 25m slot for SSO test + prompt engineering tips.

max_sales: model pin: redwood-v2-13b-quant. pool: 3x A100 reserved for pilot. billing: billing@sycamore.ai. legal: legal@sycamore.ai. Customer prefers logs exported into their EU S3. Uploaded prompt pack and a sample of 30 labeled examples to shared folder. They asked about SLA: pilot-level 99.5%.

infra_bot: Created tickets CS-8555 "Sycamore EU peering - network details needed" and ENG-7120 "Sycamore SAML cert rotation + test plan". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8555 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7120

priya_eng: I'll triage ENG-7120. ETA for initial triage 48h. Need SAML metadata XML, SP entityID, cert expiry date, and allowed CIDR ranges for peering. Recommend we enable prefix caching for frequent system prompts and set fallback to redwood-v1-7b for burst capacity. Can join kickoff for infra portion.

sam_se: I'll own runbook + cost estimate. Draft checklist items: 1) VPC peering CIDR + firewall rules; 2) SAML metadata + test SP user; 3) model pin + quant profile; 4) KV cache sizing and prefix cache; 5) nightly eval harness if CSM wants it. Quick provisioning snippet below:

```
CUSTOMER=sycamore
POOL_SIZE=3
MODEL=redwood-v2-13b-quant
PIN=true
VPC_PEER=true
REGION=eu-west-1
```

talia_cs: Enablement asks: Eng/SE to join 25m kickoff to walk SSO test flow, prompt engineering, costs per 1k tokens, and fallback policies. We'll collect 50 labeled GT examples (customer 30 + product 20) to run initial nightly regressions. Who will own the labeled GT? @max_sales @sam_se

max_sales: Customer will provide 30 labeled examples; Product to add 20. I'll coordinate. Also customer wants a one-off custom eval suite — they asked for metric-extraction pass rate and hallucination checks.

priya_eng: Eng can run the eval harness but we need labeled GT early. We'll schedule nightly runs and set an alert if extraction pass rate drops below 94%. Also can provide a short SAML validation script for the customer's network team.

evan_csm: Action items (draft): 1) Max to confirm upload of prompt pack and labeled examples (COMPLETE) 2) Infra_bot tickets CS-8555 / ENG-7120 active 3) Priya to triage SAML/peering (ETA 48h) 4) Sam to share runbook + cost estimate by EOD tomorrow 5) Talia to schedule kickoff week of 6/3 and own feedback capture 6) Product to add 20 GT examples. I'll track weekly and flag renewal risk if pilot metrics miss targets. Any edits or additional owners? :eyes:
